agyos_skill.intent: Run cross-browser automation, diagnose test failures, perform SmartUI visual regression audits, conduct WCAG accessibility evaluations, and orchestrate tests via HyperExecute on TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest).
agyos_skill.instructions: Connect and drive end-to-end testing, visual regression comparisons, accessibility audits, and test orchestration on the TestMu AI (LambdaTest) platform via Model Context Protocol (`mcp-lambdatest`). - **Server URL**: `https://mcp.lambdatest.com/mcp` - **Transport**: Remote HTTP (OAuth). - **Authentication**: On first invocation, Antigravity prompts a browser authentication flow to pair your TestMu AI / LambdaTest credentials. No manual API tokens need to be committed. | Capability Suite | Description | Key Tools | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **HyperExecute** | Generate test runner configurations and track distributed test jobs | `generateHyperExecuteConfig`, `getHyperExecuteJobStatus` | | **Automation Cloud** | Retrieve execution sessions, command logs, HAR files, and console logs | `getAutomationTestDetails`, `getAutomationLogs` | | **SmartUI** | Inspect visual diffs across pixel, layout, DOM, and perceptual dimensions | `analyzeSmartUIRun`, `summarizeSmartUILayoutDiff`, `summarizeSmartUIDomDiff` | | **Accessibility** | Audit web applications for WCAG 2.1/2.2 violations on public URLs or local tunnels | `getAccessibilityReport`, `analyseAppViaTunnel` | | **Test Manager** | Organize test cases, link execution statuses, and track milestone coverage | `manageTestCase` | 1. Identify the failing `test_id` from continuous integration logs. 2. Call `getAutomationTestDetails` to inspect device, browser, OS, and status metadata. 3. Call `getAutomationLogs` with `log_type="all"` or `log_type="console"` to retrieve command-level failures and browser console errors. 4. Synthesize root cause and suggest code fixes. 1. Given a `build_id`, run `analyzeSmartUIRun` for a complete breakdown of visual variations. 2. For layout or structural regressions, execute `summarizeSmartUILayoutDiff` and `summarizeSmartUIDomDiff`. 3. Separate intentional style changes from unintended layout shifts. 1. For production/staging URLs, run `getAccessibilityReport` with `standard="WCAG21AA"`. 2. For local dev applications, establish a secure tunnel and run `analyseAppViaTunnel`. 3. Provide remediation suggestions with exact HTML/CSS and ARIA attribute repairs. 1. Call `generateHyperExecuteConfig` specifying test framework (`playwright`, `cypress`, `selenium`), language, and desired parallel concurrency. 2. Review and save the generated `.hyperexecute.yaml` in the target project. 3. Track running executions via `getHyperExecuteJobStatus`. - Respect Antigravity tool ceilings; only enable the required tool domains if hitting context quotas.
